data.one_liner: iOS-style Cupertino date and time picker widget supporting Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable date, time, and date-time pickers in a Cupertino (iOS) style. It can be displayed as a bottom sheet or as a standalone widget, supporting dark mode and multiple locales.
use_when: You need an iOS-style date or time picker on Android or iOS.
You want built-in support for internationalization across many locales.
avoid_when: You strictly require Material Design style pickers.
You want a zero-dependency solution using Flutter's core framework widgets.
strengths: Supports bottom sheets and embedded widgets for dates, times, and combined date-times.
Built-in dark mode adaptation through theme resolution.
Extensive internationalization support out of the box.
weaknesses: Relies on a third-party fork rather than official Cupertino widgets.
Customizing languages requires modifying specific files as documented.
data.minimal_example:
DatePicker.showDatePicker(
  context,
  minDateTime: DateTime(2019, 1, 1),
  maxDateTime: DateTime(2021, 12, 31),
  initialDateTime: DateTime(2020, 6, 15),
  dateFormat: 'yyyy-MMMM-dd',
  locale: DateTimePickerLocale.en_us,
  pickerMode: DateTimePickerMode.date,
  pickerTheme: DateTimePickerTheme.Default,
  onConfirm: (dateTime, index) => print('$dateTime'),
);
